title: Gráfico Educativo Vintage de los Años 70: Guía Técnica de Estilo Ingeniería Japonesa-Alemana
prompt: A vintage-style educational chart on a textured, aged washi paper background with subtle retro mechanical elements inspired by Japanese and German engineering in the corners. The layout is a structured grid of multiple rectangular information panels, resembling a collection of technical data cards or museum plaques. Each panel has a rounded beige border with a slight embossed depth effect. Inside each panel, a sample photograph showcasing traditional crafts from Japan, Switzerland, and Denmark is positioned on the left, while clear explanatory text in Japanese with furigana, a bold title, and a small iconic symbol is placed on the right. The aesthetic is retro, informative, meticulously organized, and looks like a page from a classic 1970s technical guidebook or educational poster, with typography inspired by Swiss design principles and Japanese technical manuals.
